confidence_notes: I based the food and drink anchors on three searches. The figures came from aggregated cost-of-living sites, which gave about USD 7.50 for a basic meal, about JMD 500 (roughly USD 3) for a cappuccino and about USD 2.20–2.40 for local draft beer. An undated nightlife summary gave an average beer of about USD 4 and an average cocktail of about USD 8. Several of these sources are crowd-sourced or old. I raised the beer, coffee and meal figures a little to reflect tourist-area restaurant prices in July 2026, since tourist bars can charge much more than local bars. I found no aggregated mid-range three-course figure for Ocho Rios. Expat guides suggested about USD 30 for two, or USD 15–30 per person, so the USD 50 for two is a bounded judgement. I found no direct wine price. I estimated wine by comparison with the cocktail price and the higher cost of imported wine in Jamaica, so that anchor is less certain. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not check any booking sites or current listings. Ocho Rios has few registered hostels, so the dorm and private-room figures are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Prices are benchmarked against other Jamaican tourist towns, mainly Montego Bay and Negril. One cost-of-living source put Ocho Rios about 10% below the Jamaica average for everyday prices. Restaurant and bar prices in the tourist area are still pulled up by cruise-ship and resort demand.
